a11y.apg: The APG pattern is Meter/Progressbar: role="progressbar" with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow, all three present. No keyboard interaction — a progress bar reports, it does not accept input. That is what separates it from Range, which is a slider.

props.name: value
props.description: Percentage, 0 to 100. Clamped once and used for both the fill and aria-valuenow, so what is drawn and what is announced cannot drift apart. There is no indeterminate mode: when the total is unknown, use Spinner.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the bar. Without it the screen reader announces a bare number with no subject.
